rationale: Add a first-class Renovate process-adoption proposal whose complete candidate is protected-base verified and permanently consumer-owner-merge-only, while preserving standing auto-merge for agent-host PRs created after lifecycle completion and retaining automation-proposal schemas 1 and 2 unchanged.
migration: Release and self-adopt this capability before a separately reviewed consumer opt-in or Renovate operations activation. Consumers choosing schema 3 must pin an immutable protected-base verifier, require complete adoption provenance and materialization, keep automerge false and consumerOwnerMergeRequired true, manually merge the reviewed PR as the terminal cutover, and run no post-merge synchronization. Existing schema-1/schema-2 dependency proposal and agent-host completed-publication routes retain their released behavior.
